biomass_notes.ceramide_pool_biomass_term: sphingolipid_ceramide_pool[C_er] at 5.4e-4 mmol/gDW; the pool is filled by gene-less pseudo-reactions xPOOL_CER_* from any of the 10 ER ceramides m386, m388, m390, m391, m392, m393, m397, m398, m399, m400 (dihydro, phyto and alpha-hydroxy forms; C24 and C26)
biomass_notes.ceramide_pool_biomass_evidence: Rupcic et al. 1996 (PMID 8997745, abstract): Y. lipolytica (as Candida lipolytica) on methanol, total long-chain bases 0.7 percent of polar lipids, polar lipids 52.3 percent of lipid, lipid 4.9 percent of DCW; 0.007 x 0.523 x 0.049 = 1.794e-4 g LCB/gDW / 331.54 g/mol (C19-phytosphingosine) = 5.41e-4 mmol/gDW, one LCB per sphingolipid. Cross-check Ianutsevich et al. 2019 (PMC6950712, W29, glycerol, stationary phase): sphingolipids a minority, Fig. 4A about 1.3-2 percent of 11.2-12.98 mg membrane lipid per g (read from the figure), about 0.15-0.25 mg/gDW, 1.5-3.7e-4 mmol/gDW as intact lipid. Ylsur2 deletion viable with retarded growth (Shin et al. 2025, PMID 39603335, abstract), so the pool accepts dihydro ceramides.
biomass_notes.ceramide_pool_biomass_evidence_tier: provisional: Y. lipolytica measurements from 1996 TLC/GC (abstract only) and a figure reading, not PO1f on the Task A medium; no Y. lipolytica deletion data for LCB1, LCB2 or TSC10 (S. cerevisiae nulls inviable, SGD)
biomass_notes.ceramide_pool_biomass_scope: Only the pool metabolite, the 10 xPOOL_CER_* pseudo-reactions and this biomass_C term are added; biomass_C is not re-normalised. The complex-sphingolipid copies (census UM1), R1371, the SUR2/SCS7 rules and the R2127 ceramide-synthase rule are unchanged.
